d: Extremely long, wavy platinum white hair with blunt-cut bangs and two large blue circular mechanical headphones resting on the head. Sharp, narrow electric blue eyes on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a red bomber jacket with white cloud patterns over a white crop top, paired with a black pleated mini-skirt, a black utility belt with a gold dragon ornament, and white ankle boots. Accessories include a gold necklace, a gold thigh band on the left leg, a white quilted clutch under the left arm, and a long grey metallic staff held in the right hand.
